dct_title_s: Global - Locations of Refugees, Internally Displaced and Stateless People
dct_description_sm: Geographic point layer representing all the people of concern's known locations in the world ( Refugees, Internally displaced, Stateless persons and other of concern). The data is displayed by population type and location type (typology adapted from the SPHERE handbook standard).
